hero-calle.prompt: Editorial documentary photograph of the main street of a Mediterranean coastal campsite at mid-morning in August. A wide compacted sand-and-gravel avenue runs away from the camera under tall Aleppo pines with high open canopies. On both sides, numbered pitches with white touring caravans, green canvas awnings and simple wooden posts; dappled pine shade falls across the sand. At the far end the street opens onto a pale strip of sea and sky. Natural Mediterranean light, no HDR, no brochure saturation, muted greens and warm sand tones, subtle 35mm film grain, 35mm lens at f/5.6. No people, no text, no signage lettering, no logos, no watermarks.

Deep blue-green evening sky with a faint band of sea light low on the horizon. Natural light only, no HDR, no brochure saturation, muted palette, subtle 35mm film grain. No people, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks.
